DOHNA_DOHNA_RELIC_SQUAD_STANDARD.title: DohnaDohna Squad
DOHNA_DOHNA_RELIC_SQUAD_STANDARD.descrip: Legacy squad marker. Retained for old saves; no longer grants combat effects.
DOHNA_DOHNA_RELIC_KUMA_EMBLEM.title: Kuma's Emblem
DOHNA_DOHNA_RELIC_KUMA_EMBLEM.descriptio: Kuma and members behind him have 1 additional Strength.
DOHNA_DOHNA_RELIC_KUMA_EMBLEM_PLUS.title: Kuma's Refined Emblem
DOHNA_DOHNA_RELIC_KUMA_EMBLEM_PLUS.descr: Kuma and members behind him have 2 additional Strength.
DOHNA_DOHNA_RELIC_ALYCE_EMBLEM.title: ALyCE's Emblem
DOHNA_DOHNA_RELIC_ALYCE_EMBLEM.descripti: ALyCE deals 4 additional damage per hit to enemies attacked by another member this turn.
DOHNA_DOHNA_RELIC_ALYCE_EMBLEM_PLUS.desc: ALyCE deals 8 additional damage per hit to enemies attacked by another member this turn.
DOHNA_DOHNA_RELIC_ANTENA_EMBLEM.title: Antena's Emblem
DOHNA_DOHNA_RELIC_ANTENA_EMBLEM.descript: The first Attack Antena performs each turn grants other members 1 Dexterity this turn for each enemy hit.
DOHNA_DOHNA_RELIC_ANTENA_EMBLEM_PLUS.des: The first Attack Antena performs each turn grants other members 2 Dexterity this turn for each enemy hit.
DOHNA_DOHNA_RELIC_TORA_EMBLEM.title: Torataro's Emblem
DOHNA_DOHNA_RELIC_TORA_EMBLEM.descriptio: Each turn, each kind of positive effect grants Torataro 1 Strength for that turn, once per kind.
DOHNA_DOHNA_RELIC_TORA_EMBLEM_PLUS.title: Torataro's Refined Emblem
DOHNA_DOHNA_RELIC_TORA_EMBLEM_PLUS.descr: Each turn, each kind of positive effect grants Torataro 2 Strength for that turn, once per kind.
DOHNA_DOHNA_RELIC_KIKUCHIYO_EMBLEM.title: Kikuchiyo's Emblem
DOHNA_DOHNA_RELIC_KIKUCHIYO_EMBLEM.descr: After Kikuchiyo performs her first Attack each turn, draw 1 card.
After Kikuchiyo performs her first Attack each turn, draw 2 cards.
DOHNA_DOHNA_RELIC_MEDHICO_EMBLEM.title: Medhico's Emblem
DOHNA_DOHNA_RELIC_MEDHICO_EMBLEM.descrip: Each combat, the first member to exchange positions with Medhico heals 3 HP.
DOHNA_DOHNA_RELIC_MEDHICO_EMBLEM_PLUS.de: Each combat, the first member to exchange positions with Medhico heals 6 HP.
DOHNA_DOHNA_RELIC_JOKER_EMBLEM.title: Joker's Emblem
DOHNA_DOHNA_RELIC_JOKER_EMBLEM.descripti: Whenever Joker changes position, he gains 2 Vigor.
DOHNA_DOHNA_RELIC_JOKER_EMBLEM_PLUS.desc: Whenever Joker changes position, he gains 4 Vigor.
DOHNA_DOHNA_RELIC_ZAPPA_EMBLEM.title: Zappa's Emblem
DOHNA_DOHNA_RELIC_ZAPPA_EMBLEM.descripti: At the end of your turn, if Zappa is in front, he gains 4 Block.
DOHNA_DOHNA_RELIC_ZAPPA_EMBLEM_PLUS.desc: At the end of your turn, if Zappa is in front, he gains 8 Block.
DOHNA_DOHNA_RELIC_KIRAKIRA_EMBLEM.title: Kirakira's Emblem
DOHNA_DOHNA_RELIC_KIRAKIRA_EMBLEM.descri: At the start of each combat, choose a card in your hand. It gains Retain this combat.
DOHNA_DOHNA_RELIC_KIRAKIRA_EMBLEM_PLUS.d: At the start of each combat, choose 2 cards in your hand. They gain Retain this combat.
DOHNA_DOHNA_RELIC_PORNO_EMBLEM.title: Porno's Emblem
DOHNA_DOHNA_RELIC_PORNO_EMBLEM.descripti: Porno and the member directly in front of her have 2 additional Thorns.
DOHNA_DOHNA_RELIC_PORNO_EMBLEM_PLUS.desc: Porno and the member directly in front of her have 4 additional Thorns.
